085        @Override
086        protected boolean create(MarketAPI createdAt, boolean barEvent) {
087                // if already accepted by the player, abort
088                if (!setGlobalReference("$sdtu_ref", "$sdtu_inProgress")) {
089                        return false;
090                }
091                
092                setPersonOverride(null);
093                
094                ram = getImportantPerson(People.RAM);
095                if (ram == null) return false;
096                
097                hyder = getImportantPerson(People.HYDER);
098                if (hyder == null) return false;
099                
100                caden = getImportantPerson(People.CADEN);
101                if (caden == null) return false;
102                
103                macario = getImportantPerson(People.MACARIO);
104                if (macario == null) return false;
105                
106                
107                umbra =getMarket("umbra");
108                if (umbra == null) return false;
109                if (!umbra.getFactionId().equals("pirates")) return false;
110                
111                volturn = getMarket("volturn");
112                if (volturn == null) return false;
113                if (!volturn.getFactionId().equals("sindrian_diktat")) return false;
114                
115                sindria = getMarket("sindria");
116                if (sindria == null) return false;
117                if (!sindria.getFactionId().equals("sindrian_diktat")) return false;
118                
119                
120                
121                setStoryMission();
122                setStartingStage(Stage.MEET_RAM);
123                addSuccessStages(Stage.COMPLETED);
124                
125                marineLossesMax = 4;
126                marineLossesMin = 1;
127                marineLosses = marineLossesMin + genRandom.nextInt(marineLossesMax - marineLossesMin + 1);
128                
129                xpRewardLow = 2000;
130                xpRewardMedium = 5000;
131                xpRewardHigh = 12000;
132                
133                //payment = 10000;
134                //paymentHigh = 17000;
135                
136                patrolSecond = Global.getSector().getFaction(Factions.DIKTAT).createRandomPerson(genRandom);
137                patrolSecond.setRankId(Ranks.SPACE_LIEUTENANT);
138                patrolSecond.setPostId(Ranks.POST_FLEET_COMMANDER);
139                
140                
141                makeImportant(volturn, "$sdtu_meetRamOnVolturn", Stage.MEET_RAM);
142                makeImportant(hyder, "$sdtu_meetHyder", Stage.MEET_HYDER);
143                makeImportant(macario, "$sdtu_didHyderMeeting", Stage.RETURN_TO_MACARIO);
144                makeImportant(umbra, "$sdtu_extractAgent", Stage.EXTRACT_AGENT);
145                makeImportant(caden, "$sdtu_meetCaden", Stage.MEET_CADEN);
146                makeImportant(macario, "$sdtu_didCadenMeeting", Stage.AGAIN_WTH_MACARIO);
147                // debris field is made important in Action
148                makeImportant(macario, "$sdtu_deliverNews", Stage.DELIVER_NEWS);
149                
150                connectWithGlobalFlag(Stage.MEET_RAM, Stage.INTERCEPT_FLEET, "$sdtu_interceptFleet");
151                connectWithGlobalFlag(Stage.INTERCEPT_FLEET, Stage.MEET_HYDER, "$sdtu_meetHyder");
152                connectWithGlobalFlag(Stage.MEET_HYDER, Stage.RETURN_TO_MACARIO, "$sdtu_reportToMacario1");
153                connectWithGlobalFlag(Stage.RETURN_TO_MACARIO, Stage.EXTRACT_AGENT, "$sdtu_extractAgent");
154                connectWithGlobalFlag(Stage.EXTRACT_AGENT, Stage.MEET_CADEN, "$sdtu_meetCaden");
155                connectWithGlobalFlag(Stage.MEET_CADEN, Stage.AGAIN_WTH_MACARIO, "$sdtu_reportToMacario2");
156                connectWithGlobalFlag(Stage.AGAIN_WTH_MACARIO, Stage.EMERGENCY_INTERCEPT, "$sdtu_emergencyIntercept");
157                connectWithGlobalFlag(Stage.EMERGENCY_INTERCEPT, Stage.DELIVER_NEWS, "$sdtu_deliverNews");
158
159                setStageOnGlobalFlag(Stage.COMPLETED, "$sdtu_completed");
160                
161                setRepFactionChangesNone();
162                setRepPersonChangesNone();
163                
164                
165                // Diktat patrol with "traitor" officer for player to intercept.
166                beginStageTrigger(Stage.INTERCEPT_FLEET);
167                triggerCreateFleet(FleetSize.SMALL, FleetQuality.DEFAULT, Factions.DIKTAT, FleetTypes.PATROL_MEDIUM, sindria.getStarSystem());
168                triggerMakeNonHostile();
169                triggerMakeNoRepImpact();
170                triggerMakeFleetIgnoredByOtherFleets();
171                triggerMakeFleetIgnoreOtherFleetsExceptPlayer();
172                triggerMakeFleetIgnoreOtherFleetsExceptPlayer(); // don't go chasing others, please.
173                triggerPickLocationAroundEntity(volturn.getPlanetEntity(), 800f);
174                triggerSetFleetMissionRef("$sdtu_ref"); // so they can be made unimportant
175                triggerFleetMakeImportant(null, Stage.INTERCEPT_FLEET);
176                triggerFleetAddDefeatTrigger("sdtuPatrolDefeated");
177                triggerSaveGlobalFleetRef("$sdtu_traitorPatrol"); 
178                triggerSetPatrol();
179                triggerOrderFleetPatrol(sindria.getStarSystem());
180                triggerSpawnFleetAtPickedLocation("$sdtu_interceptFleet", null);
181                
182                endTrigger();
183                
184                // Pirate/ANTIs fleet to distract player on approach to Umbra; otherwise irrelevant to plot.
185                beginStageTrigger(Stage.EXTRACT_AGENT); 
186                triggerCreateFleet(FleetSize.LARGE, FleetQuality.DEFAULT, Factions.PIRATES, FleetTypes.PATROL_MEDIUM, umbra.getPlanetEntity());
187                triggerFleetSetName("ARC Raider Flotilla");
188                triggerSetFleetFaction(Factions.PIRATES);
189        triggerAutoAdjustFleetStrengthMajor();
190        triggerSetStandardAggroPirateFlags();
191       // triggerFleetAllowLongPursuit(); // they're not *that* dedicated
192        triggerPickLocationTowardsPlayer(umbra.getPlanetEntity(), 90f, getUnits(0.25f));
193        triggerPickLocationAroundEntity(umbra.getPlanetEntity(), 200f);
194        triggerSpawnFleetAtPickedLocation("$sdtu_antisFleet", null);
195        triggerSetFleetMissionRef("$sdtu_ref");
196        endTrigger();
197                
198                // Pirate/ANTIs fleet to distract player when leaving Umbra; otherwise irrelevant to plot.
199                beginStageTrigger(Stage.MEET_CADEN);
200                triggerCreateFleet(FleetSize.LARGER, FleetQuality.DEFAULT, Factions.PIRATES, FleetTypes.PATROL_LARGE, umbra.getPlanetEntity());
201                triggerFleetSetName("ARC Raider Patrol");
202                triggerSetFleetFaction(Factions.PIRATES);
203        triggerAutoAdjustFleetStrengthMajor();
204        triggerSetStandardAggroPirateFlags();
205        //triggerFleetAllowLongPursuit();
206        triggerPickLocationAroundEntity(umbra.getPlanetEntity(), 500f);
207        triggerSpawnFleetAtPickedLocation("$sdtu_antisRevengeFleet", null);
208        triggerSetFleetMissionRef("$sdtu_ref");
209        endTrigger();
210                
211                // I guess you can go nuts once this is done, even though it isn't quite done, is it.
212                beginStageTrigger(Stage.COMPLETED);
213                triggerSetGlobalMemoryValue("$sdtu_missionCompleted", true);
214                triggerMakeNonStoryCritical(volturn, umbra, sindria);
215                endTrigger();
216                
217                return true;
218        }

220        protected void updateInteractionDataImpl() {
221                set("$sdtu_stage", getCurrentStage());
222                set("$sdtu_extractAgentRaidDifficulty", EXTACT_AGENT_RAID_DIFFICULTY);
223                set("$sdtu_marineLosses", marineLosses);
224                set("$sdtu_patrolSecond", patrolSecond);
225                //set("$sdtu_patrolFleet", diktatPatrolFleet)
226                //set("$sdtu_payment", Misc.getWithDGS(payment));
227                //set("$sdtu_paymentHigh", Misc.getWithDGS(paymentHigh));
228                set("$sdtu_xpRewardLow", xpRewardLow);
229                set("$sdtu_xpRewardMedium", xpRewardMedium);
230                set("$sdtu_xpRewardHigh", xpRewardHigh);
231        }

233        @Override
234        protected boolean callAction(String action, String ruleId, final InteractionDialogAPI dialog,
235                                                                 List<Token> params, final Map<String, MemoryAPI> memoryMap) {
236//              if ("THEDUEL".equals(action)) {
237//                      TextPanelAPI text = dialog.getTextPanel();
238//                      text.setFontOrbitronUnnecessarilyLarge();
239//                      Color color = Misc.getBasePlayerColor();
240//                      color = Global.getSector().getFaction(Factions.HEGEMONY).getBaseUIColor();
241//                      text.addPara("THE DUEL", color);
242//                      text.setFontInsignia();
243//                      text.addImage("misc", "THEDUEL");
244//                      return true;
245//              }
246                
247                if ("spawnDebris".equals(action)) {
248                        StarSystemAPI system = sindria.getStarSystem();
249                        DebrisFieldParams p = new DebrisFieldParams(
250                                        150f, // field radius - should not go above 1000 for performance reasons
251                                        -1f, // density, visual - affects number of debris pieces
252                                        10000000f, // duration in days 
253                                        0f); // days the field will keep generating glowing pieces
254                        p.source = DebrisFieldSource.MIXED;
255                        p.baseSalvageXP = 500; // base XP for scavenging in field
256                        debris = Misc.addDebrisField(system, p, StarSystemGenerator.random);
257                        SalvageSpecialAssigner.assignSpecialForDebrisField(debris);
258                        debris.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set("$sdtuAgentDebris", true);
259                        
260                        List<SectorEntityToken> jumpPoints = system.getJumpPoints();
261                        debris.setCircularOrbit(jumpPoints.get(jumpPoints.size()-1), 90, 200, 100);
262
263                        
264                        Misc.makeImportant(debris, getMissionId());
265                        
266                        // Merc who blew away the agent.
267                beginStageTrigger(Stage.EMERGENCY_INTERCEPT);
268                        triggerCreateFleet(FleetSize.MEDIUM, FleetQuality.VERY_HIGH, Factions.MERCENARY, FleetTypes.MERC_PRIVATEER, system);
269                        triggerSetFleetFaction(Factions.INDEPENDENT);
270                        triggerFleetSetName("Mercenary Bounty Hunter");
271                        triggerSetFleetOfficers(OfficerNum.MORE, OfficerQuality.HIGHER);
272                        triggerMakeHostileAndAggressive();
273                        triggerMakeNoRepImpact();
274                        //triggerFleetAllowLongPursuit();
275                        //triggerSetFleetAlwaysPursue();
276                        triggerPickLocationAroundEntity(debris, 500f);
277                        triggerSpawnFleetAtPickedLocation("$sdtu_merc", null);
278                        triggerOrderFleetPatrol(true, debris);
279                        endTrigger();
280                        
281                        return true;
282                } else if ("makeDerbisUnimportant".equals(action)) {
283                        // need to probably store the debris in a member variable to get to it here
284                        if (debris != null)
285                        {
286                                Misc.makeUnimportant(debris, getMissionId());
287                        }
288                        return true;
289                }
290                else if ("shootEm".equals(action))
291                {
292                        Global.getSoundPlayer().playSound("storyevent_diktat_execution", 1, 1, Global.getSoundPlayer().getListenerPos(), new Vector2f());
293                        return true;
294                }
295                else if ("endMusic".equals(action))
296                {
297                        Global.getSoundPlayer().setSuspendDefaultMusicPlayback(true);
298                        Global.getSoundPlayer().pauseMusic();
299                        //Global.getSoundPlayer().restartCurrentMusic();
300                        return true;
301                }
302                else if ("playMusicMacario".equals(action))
303                {
304                        Global.getSoundPlayer().playCustomMusic(1, 1, "music_diktat_market_hostile", true);
305                        return true;
306                }
307                else if ("playMusicCaden".equals(action))
308                {
309                        Global.getSoundPlayer().playCustomMusic(1, 1, "music_diktat_encounter_hostile", true);
310                        return true;
311                }
312                else if ("playMusicHyder".equals(action))
313                {
314                        Global.getSoundPlayer().playCustomMusic(1, 1, "music_diktat_encounter_friendly", true);
315                        return true;
316                } 
317                else if ("playMusicSons".equals(action))
318                {
319                        Global.getSoundPlayer().playCustomMusic(1, 1, "music_diktat_market_friendly", true);
320                        return true;
321                } 
322                else if ("resumeMusic".equals(action))
323                {
324                        Global.getSoundPlayer().setSuspendDefaultMusicPlayback(false);
325                        Global.getSoundPlayer().restartCurrentMusic();
326                        return true;
327                }
328                else if ("giveKineticBlasters".equals(action)) {
329                        CargoAPI cargo = Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet().getCargo();
330                        cargo.addWeapons("kineticblaster", 3);
331                        CargoStackAPI stack = Global.getFactory().createCargoStack(CargoItemType.RESOURCES, Commodities.SHIP_WEAPONS, cargo);
332                        AddRemoveCommodity.addStackGainText(stack, dialog.getTextPanel());
333                        return true;
334                }
335                else if ("giveGigacannon".equals(action)) {
336                        CargoAPI cargo = Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet().getCargo();
337                        cargo.addWeapons("gigacannon", 2);
338                        CargoStackAPI stack = Global.getFactory().createCargoStack(CargoItemType.RESOURCES, Commodities.SHIP_WEAPONS, cargo);
339                        AddRemoveCommodity.addStackGainText(stack, dialog.getTextPanel());
340                        return true;
341                }
342                else if ("giveLesserLGCraft".equals(action)) {
343                        String variantId = "falcon_LG_Hull";
344                        ShipVariantAPI variant = Global.getSettings().getVariant(variantId).clone();
345                        variant.setSource(VariantSource.REFIT);
346                        FleetMemberAPI member = Global.getFactory().createFleetMember(FleetMemberType.SHIP, variant);
347                        Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet().getFleetData().addFleetMember(member);
348                        AddShip.addShipGainText(member, dialog.getTextPanel()); 
349                        return true;
350                }
351                else if ("giveExecutor".equals(action)) {
352                    String variantId = "executor_Hull";
353                        ShipVariantAPI variant = Global.getSettings().getVariant(variantId).clone();
354                        variant.setSource(VariantSource.REFIT);
355                        FleetMemberAPI member = Global.getFactory().createFleetMember(FleetMemberType.SHIP, variant);
356                        Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet().getFleetData().addFleetMember(member);
357                        AddShip.addShipGainText(member, dialog.getTextPanel()); 
358                        return true;
359                }
360                else if ("replacePatrolLeader".equals(action)) {
361
362                        /*for (CampaignFleetAPI fleet : volturn.getStarSystem().getFleets()) {
363                                if (fleet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().contains("$sdtu_interceptFleet")) {
364                                        fleet.setCommander(patrolSecond);
365                                }
366                        }*/
367                        CampaignFleetAPI fleet = (CampaignFleetAPI)dialog.getInteractionTarget();
368                        fleet.setCommander(patrolSecond);
369                        fleet.getAI().addAssignmentAtStart(FleetAssignment.STANDING_DOWN, fleet, 0.5f + 0.5f * (float) Math.random(), null);
370                        //dialog.getInteractionTarget().setActivePerson(patrolSecond);
371                        
372                        CampaignFleetAPI pf = Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet();
373                        BattleAPI b = pf.getBattle();
374                        if (b != null) {
375                                b.leave(pf, false);
376                                //b.finish(null);
377                        }
378                        
379                        //fleet.setNoEngaging(3f); // not needed
380                        return true;
381                }
382                else if ("tryMakeHyderImportant".equals(action)){
383                        for (CampaignFleetAPI fleet : volturn.getStarSystem().getFleets()) {
384                                if (fleet.getName().equals("Askonia System Defense Armada")){
385                                        Misc.makeImportant(fleet, "$sdtu_ref");
386                                }
387                        }
388                        return true;
389                }
390                else if ("tryMakeHyderUnimportant".equals(action)){
391                        for (CampaignFleetAPI fleet : volturn.getStarSystem().getFleets()) {
392                                if (fleet.getName().equals("Askonia System Defense Armada")){
393                                        Misc.makeUnimportant(fleet, "$sdtu_ref");
394                                }
395                        }
396                        return true;
397                }
398                else if ("tryMakeCadenImportant".equals(action)){
399                        for (CampaignFleetAPI fleet : volturn.getStarSystem().getFleets()) {
400                                if (fleet.getName().equals("Lion's Guard Grand Armada")){
401                                        Misc.makeImportant(fleet, "$sdtu_ref");
402                                }
403                        }
404                        return true;
405                }
406                else if ("tryMakeCadenUnimportant".equals(action)){
407                        for (CampaignFleetAPI fleet : volturn.getStarSystem().getFleets()) {
408                                if (fleet.getName().equals("Lion's Guard Grand Armada")){
409                                        Misc.makeUnimportant(fleet, "$sdtu_ref");
410                                }
411                        }
412                        return true;
413                }
414                else if ("makeMercHostile".equals(action)){
415                        for (CampaignFleetAPI fleet : volturn.getStarSystem().getFleets()) {
416                                if (fleet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().contains("$sdtu_merc")){
417                                        //Misc.makeUnimportant(fleet, "$sdtu_ref");
418                                        fleet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(MemFlags.MEMORY_KEY_ALLOW_LONG_PURSUIT, true);
419                                        //fleet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set("$ignorePlayerCommRequests", true);
420                                        Misc.makeHostile(fleet);
421                                        
422                                        AbilityPlugin eb = fleet.getAbility(Abilities.EMERGENCY_BURN);
423                                        if (eb != null && eb.isUsable()) eb.activate();
424                                }
425                        }
426                        return true;
427                }
428                else if ("saveTheDate".equals(action)) {
429                        Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set("$sd7s_cydoniaDate", Global.getSector().getClock().getDateString());  //getShortDate());
430                        Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set("$sd7s_cydoniaDate2", Global.getSector().getClock().getShortDate());
431                        return true;
432                }
433                
434                
435                return super.callAction(action, ruleId, dialog, params, memoryMap);
436        }

438        @Override
439        public void addDescriptionForNonEndStage(TooltipMakerAPI info, float width, float height) {
440                float opad = 10f;
441                Color h = Misc.getHighlightColor();
442                
443                //info.addImage(robed_man.getPortraitSprite(), width, 128, opad);
444                
445                if (currentStage == Stage.MEET_RAM) {
446                        info.addPara("Meet Yannick Ram at his safehouse on Volturn. He has a plan to save the Sindrian Diktat from itself.", opad);
447                        addStandardMarketDesc("Ram gave you coordinates to his safehouse " + volturn.getOnOrAt(), volturn, info, opad);
448                }
449                else if (currentStage == Stage.INTERCEPT_FLEET) {
450                        info.addPara("Find and intercept a Sindrian Diktat patrol fleet led by the 'treasonous' officer. It can be found in the Askonia system.", opad);
451                }
452                else if (currentStage == Stage.MEET_HYDER) {
453                        info.addPara("Use the 'treasonous' officer as leverage to gain access to Deputy Star Marshal Hyder. She can be found in command of the Askonia System Defense Armada, a large warfleet patrolling the Askonia star system.", opad);
454                }
455                else if (currentStage == Stage.RETURN_TO_MACARIO) {
456                        info.addPara("Report back to Macario about your conversation with Hyder.", opad);
457                        addStandardMarketDesc("Chief High Inspector-General Macario is based " + sindria.getOnOrAt(), sindria, info, opad);
458                }
459                else if (currentStage == Stage.EXTRACT_AGENT) {
460                        info.addPara("Extract a known double-agent who, while working for Horacio Caden, has betrayed the Sindrian Diktat.", opad);
461                        addStandardMarketDesc("The 'treasonous' double-agent is based " + umbra.getOnOrAt(), umbra, info, opad);
462                }
463                else if (currentStage == Stage.MEET_CADEN) {
464                        info.addPara("Use the 'treasonous' agent as leverage to gain access to Guard High Lieutenant-Executor Caden. He can be found in command of the Lion's Guard Grand Armada, a large warfleet patrolling the Askonia star system.", opad);
465                }
466                else if (currentStage == Stage.AGAIN_WTH_MACARIO) {
467                        info.addPara("Report back to Macario about your conversation with Caden.", opad);
468                        addStandardMarketDesc("Chief High Inspector-General Macario is based " + sindria.getOnOrAt(), sindria, info, opad);
469                }
470                else if (currentStage == Stage.EMERGENCY_INTERCEPT) {
471                        info.addPara("Intercept and assist or capture Macario's agent at the Fringe Jump-point of Askonia.", opad);
472                }
473                else if (currentStage == Stage.DELIVER_NEWS) {
474                        info.addPara("Report back to Macario with news of his agent's demise.", opad);
475                }
476        }

478        @Override
479        public boolean addNextStepText(TooltipMakerAPI info, Color tc, float pad) {
480                Color h = Misc.getHighlightColor();
481                if (currentStage == Stage.MEET_RAM) {
482                        info.addPara("Meet Yannick Ram at his safehouse on Volturn.", tc, pad);
483                        return true;
484                }
485                if (currentStage == Stage.INTERCEPT_FLEET) {
486                        info.addPara("Intercept the traitor's patrol fleet in the Askonia system.", tc, pad);
487                        return true;
488                }
489                else if (currentStage == Stage.MEET_HYDER) {
490                        info.addPara("Speak with Oxana Hyder. She commands the Askonia System Defense Armada.", tc, pad);
491                        return true;
492                }
493                else if (currentStage == Stage.RETURN_TO_MACARIO) {
494                        info.addPara("Talk to Macario, on Sindria, about Hyder.", tc, pad);
495                        return true;
496                }
497                else if (currentStage == Stage.EXTRACT_AGENT) {
498                        info.addPara("Extract the double agent from Umbra.", tc, pad);
499                        return true;
500                }
501                else if (currentStage == Stage.MEET_CADEN) {
502                        info.addPara("Speak with Horacio Caden. He commands the Lion's Guard Grand Armada.", tc, pad);
503                        return true;
504                }
505                else if (currentStage == Stage.AGAIN_WTH_MACARIO) {
506                        info.addPara("Talk to Macario, on Sindria, about Caden.", tc, pad);
507                        return true;
508                }
509                else if (currentStage == Stage.EMERGENCY_INTERCEPT) {
510                        info.addPara("Intercept Macario's agent at the given location.", tc, pad);
511                        return true;
512                }
513                else if (currentStage == Stage.DELIVER_NEWS) {
514                        info.addPara("Return to Macario, on Sindria, with news of his agent's death.", tc, pad);
515                        return true;
516                }
517                return false;
518        }
519
520        @Override
521        public String getBaseName() {
522                return "The Usurpers";
523        }
524
525        @Override
526        public String getPostfixForState() {
527                if (startingStage != null) {
528                        return "";
529                }
530                return super.getPostfixForState();
531        }
